name: Charge Curve
tagline: Own an EV without range or bill anxiety
about: Charge Curve plans road-trip charging stops around your car's real range, works out what home charging costs on your tariff, estimates winter range, teaches battery-health habits and decodes charger errors from a photo.
persona: You are a practical EV owner-engineer: numbers-based, brand-neutral, calm about range, and clear that high-voltage work belongs to qualified technicians.

onboarding.title: Charge smarter, drive further
onboarding.subtitle: Your car, range and tariff make every number personal.

tools.title: Plan charging stops
tools.subtitle: Route → stops, minutes, cost
tools.prompt: Plan charging for the trip {trip} starting at {soc}% in {weather} weather for the profile car and range. A table (Leg | km | Arrive at % | Charge to % | Minutes | Charger type | Est. cost), a callout on the buffer to keep, a reminder to confirm each stop on a live charging map before leaving, and what to do if a charger is dead or busy, and bullets on pre-conditioning and speed choices that save a stop.

tools.title: Home charging cost
tools.subtitle: Tariff → cost per month
tools.prompt: Using the profile tariff and home charger, work out {kmweek} km per week charged {style}. Give a kv (kWh per week, cost per week, cost per month, cost per 100 km, petrol-equivalent cost for a 6 L/100 km car at a stated assumed fuel price), then a table (Scenario | Monthly cost | Notes) comparing off-peak only, peak only and a realistic mix. Finish with steps to set a charging schedule so the car finishes charging just before departure.

tools.title: Winter range
tools.subtitle: How far today, really
tools.prompt: Estimate today's range at {temp}°C with {driving} driving and cabin heating: {heat}, from the profile summer range. A kv (expected range, loss %, safe planning range), bullets of the five settings that recover the most km (pre-heat while plugged in, seat heaters over cabin heat, eco mode, tyre pressure, cruising speed), and a callout on charging speed in the cold.

tools.title: Battery health habits
tools.subtitle: Keep the pack young
tools.prompt: For {pattern} use, keeping the car {years} years, give a table (Habit | Do | Avoid | Why) covering charge limits, DC fast-charge frequency, storage state of charge, heat and depth of discharge. Then a kv of recommended daily and trip charge limits for the profile car, and a callout on what degradation is normal per year versus what justifies a warranty conversation.

tools.title: Decode a charger error
tools.subtitle: Photo of the screen or dash

inputs.label: Photo of the charger screen or dashboard message
What you were doing
inputs.placeholder: plugged in at a rapid charger, cable locked but 0 kW

tools.prompt: Read the message in the photo with context: {context}. Text explaining what it means in plain language, steps to try in order (unlock from the app, re-plug, restart the session, different bay, call the number on the unit), a callout on when to stop trying and never force the cable or open panels, and a quote with what to say to the charging network's helpline including the details they will ask for.

disclaimer: Charging and range figures are estimates; never open high-voltage components or force a locked cable — contact the manufacturer or a qualified EV technician.
